a.lede: US cybersecurity company F5 warned customers to patch five critical BIG-IP vulnerabilities that attackers can exploit to trigger denial-of-service (DoS) or gain remote code execution. [...]
a.title: F5 releases emergency patches for critical BIG-IP RCE flaws

b.lede: Following devastating hacks that caused European fridges to reach 50 degrees Celsius, destroying food stocks, the U.K. has implemented nationwide patching to ensure similar attacks won't affect its fridges.
b.title: Thousands of vulnerable fridges patched against cyberattacks in secret operation
